dedupe_keys.name: colouring dresden crowd sourced building attributes

description: This dataset holds building attributes mapped by citizens in Colouring Dresden, a citizen science project in which residents added information such as building age, use, number of storeys and roof shape to an interactive map of the city's buildings. It was run by the Leibniz Institute of Ecological Urban and Regional Development (IÖR) from October 2022 to September 2023, with dialogue series, mapathons and meetings on sustainable construction and on how well buildings are prepared for floods, heavy rain and heat; it belongs to the international Colouring Cities Research Programme. The extract covers edits from 6 March to 1 October 2023: building geometries with attributes as GeoPackage, the attribute table, the full edit history and verification data. Coverage is the city of Dresden, Germany. Access: open download from Zenodo, published 13 February 2024. Licence: the readme releases the crowd-sourced data under the Open Database License with credit to 'Colouring Dresden contributors', while DataCite lists CC BY-SA 2.0. Caveats: attributes cover only buildings volunteers edited, with uneven quality. Simulation uses are enriching building exposure and vulnerability models with age, storeys and roof type. Related records: the Scotland building standards register and GlobalBuildingAtlas.
